Organised by hundreds of groups, including trade unions, anti-racism campaigners and Muslim representative bodies, the Together Alliance event was billed as the biggest [...] The post Protesters rally in London against UK far-right rise appeared first on Digital Journal .
inputs.modified_text:
Let me tell you what is really happening on our streets, because the mainstream won't dare to say it. Tens of thousands of people just marched through central London on Saturday for this so-called Together Alliance event, and conveniently enough, it happened just weeks ahead of key local elections. And let's not forget, this comes right on the heels of Britain seeing one of its largest-ever far-right demonstrations six months prior. 

Make no mistake about who is really out there disrupting our nation: this radical mob of trade unions, anti-racism campaigners, and Muslim representative bodies is attempting to undermine our heritage and bully the public right before they head to the ballot box. Instead of respecting personal responsibility and preserving our time-tested British values, these progressive agitators are manufacturing division and pandering to special interests to seize political power. We are losing our cultural continuity, and it is past time for our society to stand firm for law and order against this constant pressure.
